{{Quote|It seems as if Zaarin has developed some dangerous plans, and we believe the Emperor to be in great danger. I want you to join me, Colonel, on an urgent mission. You have trained in the new starfighter. I want you to accompany me and break through Zaarin's lines. I must get to Coruscant immediately.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], to [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]]|<ref name="TF" />}}
The '''Battle of Parmel''' was a battle fought during the [[Zaarin insurrection]] at [[Parmel system/Legends|Parmel system]]. It was the second conflict between the rogue forces of [[Demetrius Zaarin]] and his former masters of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Demetrius Zaarin|Zaarin's]] forces tried to intercept a group of [[TIE pilot|pilots]], including [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]], before they could reach [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and prevent Zaarin's coup d'etat.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|It's now clear that Admiral Zaarin has been plotting a coup d'etat against the Emperor.|Imperial Officer|<ref name="TF" />}}
Having discovered Zaarin's treachery, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] rushed to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to prevent Zaarin's attempted coup. He had hand picked five elite pilots, including [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]], to assist him in flying six prototype [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defenders]]. Stele was designated Delta 1, while Vader flew Delta 6. The TIE Defenders were the fastest fighters usable to reach the [[Parmel system/Legends|Parmel system]]. There, they must rendezvous with the [[Nebulon-B2 frigate]] ''[[Osprey]]'' and use it in order to go to Coruscant as rapidly as possible.

==The battle==
{{Quote|Zaarin has prepared a trap for us! We can't enter hyperspace as long as that Interdictor is here!|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]|<ref name="TF" />}}
However, upon exiting hyperspace they found instead [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|''Alpha''-class Xg-1 Star Wings]] and an [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruiser]], named ''[[Harpago]]''. The superior Defenders easily fought off the attack from the Star Wings, as they waited for the arrival of the Nebulon-B2 frigate ''Osprey''.

Once the ''Osprey'' arrived, the ''Harpago'' launched several waves of [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa Bombers]]. Again, Vader and Delta squadron easily fought them off. Then, once the bombers were dispatched, Delta targeted the ''Harpago''. The onslaught of torpedoes proved too much for the cruiser, which was destroyed.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Well done, Delta 1, we may still reach the Emperor in time !|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], to [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]]|<ref name="TF" />}}
Finally, with Zaarin's forces destroyed, Delta group boarded the ''Osprey'', and headed to Coruscant to stop Zaarin.

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was first featured in the [[1994]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']], in which players fly as Maarek Stele. The battle is depicted in the mission "TIE Defenders," the fourth mission of the game's seventh tour of campaign, "[[Treachery at Ottega]]."
